welcome.title: Pick a difficulty to start
welcome.desc: 104 cards · 10 columns · build 8 K→A suited runs to win

rules.title: How to play
rules.build: Any card can be placed on a card one rank higher (e.g. 8♦ onto 9♠)
rules.run: A same-suit descending run (e.g. 9♠8♠7♠) moves as a group
rules.click: Click a run to send it to a fitting spot (same-suit first); drag to pick the destination yourself
rules.flip: Face-down cards flip over when uncovered
rules.deal: Click the stock pile to deal one card per column — not allowed while any column is empty
rules.complete: A completed K→A suited run is collected automatically, +100 points
rules.score: Start at 500 points, each action costs 1 point, minimum 0
rules.shortcut: Shortcuts: U / Ctrl+Z undo · H hint · D deal · N new game · R rules

confirm.switch: Current progress will be lost. Start a new game?
